Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change the provider, gateway and scope options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.
